refs/hatcher-algebraic-topology/AT.txt:15531-15534 VERBATIM: "Corollary 3.39. If M is a closed connected orientable n manifold, then an element
α ∈ H k (M; Z) generates an infinite cyclic summand of H k (M; Z) iff there exists an
element β ∈ H n−k (M; Z) such that α ` β is a generator of H n (M; Z) ≈ Z . With
coefficients in a field this holds for any α ≠ 0 ."
